message:
Power outages can feel a bit unsettling, but I like to think of them as an opportunity for a cozy night in! 🌙 Whether it’s lighting some candles, pulling out my favorite board games, or just enjoying a little quiet time with a good book, I find there's something special about embracing the stillness. 

I came across a great resource from the Red Cross that offers some practical tips on how to prepare for these moments. It’s all about making the best of the situation and turning a potential hassle into a cherished memory. 

What’s your go-to trick for making power outages feel more like an adventure? I'd love to hear your ideas!
